Section.name: INTRO
Section.Description_ENG: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- To change the videos, simple change the filename from the "INTRO" folder. The file extension (*.bik, *.smk) can be ommitted. In that case the game tries to open the file with the *.bik (Bink Video) extension, and if that fails then fall back to *.smk (Smacker Video) files. If you do not want a video to be played, just delete the path. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Property.name: NO_DEFAULT_VALUES
Property.Description_ENG: If you set this to TRUE, all the default JA2 videos will be disabled (not shown to the user).
